name: callouts
description: Makes what needs you impossible to miss, in three tiers. Blockers, `> [!ACTION]` and `> [!SECRET]`, draw as bright yellow cards; questions, `> [!ASK]` and `> [!INPUT]`, as violet cards; `> [!REVIEW]` draws as a violet outline for things worth a look. All stay listed above the prompt, blockers first, each with its answer, until answered, dismissed or marked seen. A key typed into a SECRET shows as dots and goes straight into its .env file, never the chat. `> [!DONE]` draws as a finished banner. Colours follow the Devdeck theme
